title: NTT Global Data Centers VA10 Air Permit 74260-2
summary: Virginia DEQ's issued-permit registry links the Prince William County VA10 facility to minor new-source-review permit 74260-2 issued April 3, 2026.
key_findings: The registry identifies a named Prince William County facility and issued permit.
The record supplies a second 2026 facility-level air-permit trail outside Loudoun.
The issued permit does not establish facility completion, service, or compliant operation.
why_it_matters: It broadens the implementation dossier across the Northern Virginia corridor without adding a new geography.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a named Prince William follow-up target.
Supports later permit testing and compliance checks.
Allows cross-county comparison under the same state rail.
evidence_limits: The permit is not proof of construction or generator testing.
It does not establish electricity service, operating capacity, or emissions outcomes.
